    import sys

    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    index = 0
    results = []

    T = int(input[index])
    index += 1

    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[index])
        P = list(map(int, input[index + 1].split()))
        index += 2

        cost = 0
        operations = []
        pos = {x: i for i, x in enumerate(P)}

        for i in range(N):
            while P[i] != i + 1:
                correct_pos = pos[i + 1]
                P[i], P[correct_pos] = P[correct_pos], P[i]
                cost += abs(i - correct_pos)
                operations.append((i + 1, correct_pos + 1))
                pos[P[correct_pos]] = correct_pos
                pos[P[i]] = i

        results.append(f"{cost}\n{len(operations)}\n" + "\n".join(f"{i} {j}" for i, j in operations))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(results))

main()
